name: public_caiso_carbon

co2_biogas_mt_per_h.description: CAISO-published CO2 emission rate of one resource group (unit as printed on https://www.caiso.com/todays-outlook/emissions)

co2_biomass_mt_per_h.description: CAISO-published CO2 emission rate of one resource group (unit as printed on https://www.caiso.com/todays-outlook/emissions)

co2_natural_gas_mt_per_h.description: CAISO-published CO2 emission rate of one resource group (unit as printed on https://www.caiso.com/todays-outlook/emissions)

co2_coal_mt_per_h.description: CAISO-published CO2 emission rate of one resource group (unit as printed on https://www.caiso.com/todays-outlook/emissions)

co2_imports_mt_per_h.description: CAISO-published CO2 emission rate of one resource group (unit as printed on https://www.caiso.com/todays-outlook/emissions)

co2_geothermal_mt_per_h.description: CAISO-published CO2 emission rate of one resource group (unit as printed on https://www.caiso.com/todays-outlook/emissions)

co2_total_mt_per_h.description: sum of the CAISO CO2 resource columns

supply_mw.description: sum of all fuelsource columns (net of battery charging)

intensity_kg_per_mwh.description: 1000 * co2_total_mt_per_h / supply_mw; computed here, not published by CAISO; negative while CAISO's published imports CO2 is negative (net export)

in_state_generation_mw.description: sum of the fuelsource columns except imports, batteries clipped at zero

intensity_in_state_kg_per_mwh.description: 1000 * (CO2 of non-import resources) / in_state_generation_mw; computed here, never negative

source.title: CAISO Today's Outlook history: co2.csv and fuelsource.csv
source.license: CAISO public market data; no explicit open license found. Cited with source; check CAISO terms before redistribution.

notes: Intensity is a derived quantity (see column description); the import emission factor inside CAISO's co2.csv is CAISO's own.
